rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the arrival or onset of something.

example.english: Before the advent of the New Year, we need to clean the whole house.
example.traditional: 新年到來之前，我哋要大掃除。
example.jyutping: san1 nin4 dou3 loi4 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daai6 sou3 ceoi4

rows.note: Use this mainly for the approaching or onset aspect, especially in more formal descriptions of an event or period.

example.english: With the advent of the rainy season, mountain roads become even more slippery.
example.traditional: 隨住雨季來臨，山路會更加濕滑。
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zyu6 jyu5 gwai3 loi4 lam4 saan1 lou6 wui5 gang3 gaa1 sap1 waat6
